{{ElectionsWY}}
The '''2024 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming''' was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. representative]] for {{ushr|WY|AL}}. The election coincided with [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2024 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming, 2024 |url=https://ballotpedia.org/United_States_House_of_Representatives_election_in_Wyoming,_2024 |access-date=2024-02-22 |website=Ballotpedia |language=en}}</ref> The primary elections took place on August 20, 2024.

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
==== Nominee ====
* [[Harriet Hageman]], incumbent U.S. representative<ref>{{Cite web |last=Woodward |first=Chris |date=January 6, 2024 |title=Representative Harriet Hageman running for second term in Congress |url=https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/representative-harriet-hageman-running-for-second-term-in-congress |access-date=2024-01-06 |work=[[The Washington Examiner]]}}</ref>

==== Eliminated in primary ====
* Steven Helling, attorney and Democratic candidate for U.S. House in [[2022 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming|2022]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2024-05-31 |title=Wyoming's Primary Election Is Set: 167 Candidates In 72 Contested Races |url=https://cowboystatedaily.com/2024/05/31/wyomings-primary-election-is-set-167-candidates-in-72-contested-races/ |access-date=2024-06-01 |website=cowboystatedaily.com |language=en}}</ref>
